title: TRACE-Bench: Decomposing and Diagnosing Multi-Reference Image Generation
abstract: arXiv:2608.16765v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Despite recent advances in unified multimodal models for multi-reference image generation, existing benchmarks remain organized around predefined task types (e.g., "subject composition"), which are ill-suited to this combinatorial setting and lead to fragmented coverage, uncontrolled complexity, and little diagnostic value. Recognizing that diverse multi-reference tasks share a common set of atomic operations, we adopt a capability-oriented perspective and formalize four operators: Anchor ($f$), Disentangle ($g$), Apply ($\oplus$), and Compose ($C$). Any multi-reference prompt can then be represented as a compositional formula over these operators, whose structural complexity is quantified by the number of operator slots. translated_title: TRACE-Bench：分解与诊断多参考图像生成
translated_abstract: 尽管在多参考图像生成的统一多模态模型方面取得了近期进展，现有基准仍围绕预定义的任务类型（如“主体组合”）组织，这不适应该组合性设置，导致覆盖碎片化、复杂度不可控且诊断价值有限。认识到多样化的多参考任务共享一组原子操作，我们采用能力导向视角，并形式化四个算子：锚定（$f$）、解耦（$g$）、应用（$\oplus$）和组合（$C$）。任何多参考提示可表示为这些算子上的组合公式，其结构复杂度通过算子槽位数来量化。基于此公式，我们构建了TRACE-Bench，包含约1600个评估案例，槽位数从1到8，由631个公式模板和约4000张覆盖多样艺术风格的参考图像构成。
tldr: 本文提出TRACE-Bench，通过形式化四个原子操作（锚定、解耦、应用、组合）来分解多参考图像生成任务，并以槽位数量化复杂度，构建了约1600个案例的诊断性基准。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces TRACE-Bench, which decomposes multi-reference image generation via four atomic operators (Anchor, Disentangle, Apply, Compose) and quantifies complexity by slot counts, building a diagnostic benchmark of ~1,600 cases.
